web-guide-idea-38.audience: Students exploring a profession you have actually worked in.
web-guide-idea-38.offer: Sell an honest conversation about the day-to-day reality of your role. Separate personal experience from claims about the entire industry.
web-guide-idea-38.steps.0: Ask what role interests the guest.
web-guide-idea-38.steps.1: Walk through a typical day, tools and early-career surprises.
web-guide-idea-38.steps.2: Answer questions and suggest what they could investigate next.
web-guide-idea-38.equipment: A phone and quiet corner; anonymised examples can help, but never show confidential work.
web-guide-idea-38.returnReason: Offer follow-ups for a different aspect of the role, such as teamwork or preparing a first project.
web-guide-idea-38.promotion: Describe your real experience accurately and preview one practical topic. Avoid salary or job guarantees.
web-guide-idea-38.metadataTitle: First Job Reality Check — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-38.metadataDescription: Share firsthand experience of your profession: everyday tasks, expectations and lessons from starting out. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
